exposure: empirical broad-spectrum antibiotics in the first week of life
cohort: The study included 365 premature neonates with gestational age <=32 weeks and birth weight <1500 g who survived and had no confirmed sepsis in the first week of life.
finding: Administration of empirical broad-spectrum antibiotics in the first week of life was independently associated with a composite outcome of late-onset sepsis, necrotizing enterocolitis, and death.
